notSimulated.why: The engine reports current, not luminous intensity. The drawing scales current by 10 mA, so the glow is 1 at 10 mA and blooms above that. The forward curve is fitted from 2 mA to 20 mA through (1.70 V, 2 mA), (1.90 V, 10 mA) and (2.00 V, 20 mA). Below 2 mA and above 20 mA the current is that curve extended. A threshold at 1 mA would sit outside the fit. Luminous intensity versus forward current is drawn as a straight line from 0 mA, so the extended current still glows in proportion.
The fit is at 25 C and the engine has no temperature.
The engine's LED has no breakdown voltage.
